explication: This is a Kong Gateway plugin for Datadog APM. A request enters Kong, where the plugin captures trace data and reports it to a Datadog Agent; plugin configuration can be supplied at registration or through environment variables. The source tree separates Kong integration, span and sampling logic, propagation, and agent writing/encoding. Runtime files were not sampled, so internal call relationships are not asserted; dashed edges with no evidence path mark unverified relationships rather than confirmed calls.
